Diebolt Vallois
FRANCE - CHAMPAGNE18 products
Sustainable (HVE)

Based in the Grand Cru village of Cramant, the heart of the Cote des Blancs, Diebolt-Vallois is a benchmark family-run grower estate. They are masters of Chardonnay, crafting Champagnes celebrated for their purity, chiseled structure, and intense chalky minerality. While their classic range is stellar, the top cuvee, "Fleur de Passion," is truly exceptional. Sourced from old vines, it is vinified in old oak barrels without malolactic fermentation, resulting in a wine of profound depth, complexity, and incredible aging potential that perfectly expresses the soul of Cramant.

Domaine Vincey
FRANCE - CHAMPAGNE7 products
NEWBiodynamic

A relative newcomer making a huge impact, Domaine Vincey is a micro-grower in the Grand Cru village of Oger. Quentin Vincey has transformed his family's vineyards with an uncompromising focus on organic and biodynamic viticulture. His philosophy centers on single-vineyard, single-vintage expressions, vinified entirely in oak barrels with extended lees aging and minimal dosage. The resulting wines are powerful, vinous, and deeply terroir-driven, showcasing a rich texture balanced by electric acidity and the profound chalkiness of the Cote des Blancs.

As one of the few remaining large, independent, and family-owned Champagne houses, Duval-Leroy stands as a pillar of the region. Headquartered in Vertus and led for decades by the formidable Carol Duval-Leroy, the house is noted for its pioneering work in sustainability and its technical precision. Their style emphasizes finesse, elegance, and lightness of touch, with a strong focus on Chardonnay. From their highly regarded "Femme de Champagne" prestige cuvee to their single-vineyard offerings, the wines consistently deliver a refined, delicate, and sophisticated experience.

Egly-Ouriet
FRANCE - CHAMPAGNE16 products
Practicing Organic/Sustainable

Francis Egly of Egly-Ouriet is a titan of the grower Champagne movement and a true visionary. From his base in the Grand Cru village of Ambonnay, he crafts profound, terroir-driven Champagnes with a primary focus on Pinot Noir. His methods-old vines, low yields, barrel fermentation, and exceptionally long lees aging-were once revolutionary and are now emulated by many. His wines are renowned for their power, vinous texture, and staggering complexity. They are rich and deeply savory, yet possess an incredible mineral core, setting the benchmark for intense, gastronomic Champagne.

Eric Rodez
FRANCE - CHAMPAGNE10 products
Biodynamic

Eric Rodez, the eighth generation of his family in the Grand Cru village of Ambonnay, brings a unique perspective shaped by his time as a cellar master at Krug. A master of blending and a devotee of biodynamics, Rodez vinifies each of his many vineyard parcels separately in small oak barrels. This meticulous approach allows him to create extraordinarily complex and multi-layered blends. His Champagnes are rich and oxidative, with a vinous power derived from Ambonnay Pinot Noir, all while retaining a remarkable vibrancy and intricate detail that clearly reflects his prestigious training.

Jacquesson
FRANCE - CHAMPAGNE13 products
Sustainable (HVE)

Based in Dizy, Jacquesson is a revolutionary house that boldly abandoned the conventional non-vintage model of consistency. Instead, their numbered "700-series" cuvees are designed to be the best possible expression of a single base vintage, supplemented by reserve wines. Led by the Chiquet brothers, the house champions a philosophy of minimal intervention, with fermentation in old oak foudres, extended lees aging, and very low dosage. The wines are precise, taut, and intensely mineralic, offering a pure, unadorned, and intellectual Champagne experience.

Though a newer name in Champagne, the Labruyere family possesses a deep winemaking heritage, with esteemed properties in Burgundy (Domaine Jacques Prieur) and Bordeaux. Their Champagne project is centered on the powerful Pinot Noir of the Verzenay Grand Cru in the Montagne de Reims. They apply a Burgundian sensibility to their craft, focusing on terroir expression and meticulous, parcel-by-parcel vinification. Louis Barthelemy
FRANCE - CHAMPAGNE5 products

Now part of a larger group but maintaining its boutique focus, Louis Barthelemy is a Champagne house centered on sourcing high-quality grapes from the region's finest Grand Cru villages, particularly Ay. The house style is rich, complex, and gastronomic, with Pinot Noir often playing a leading role in the blends. A commitment to extended lees aging imparts significant depth and toasty, brioche-like complexity to the wines. They produce full-bodied, structured Champagnes with a vinous character that makes them exceptionally well-suited for pairing with fine cuisine.

Jean-Paul Hebrart has elevated his family's estate in Mareuil-sur-Ay to the top tier of grower-producers. Farming pristine vineyards in the Premier Cru villages of the Grande Vallee de la Marne, Hebrart is celebrated for crafting Champagnes of exquisite balance and textural grace. While often Pinot Noir-dominant, his wines defy expectation with their remarkable elegance and finesse, avoiding overt power. They are known for their generous fruit character, which is seamlessly integrated with a precise, chalky minerality and a distinctively silky, refined mouthfeel.

Based in Epernay, Pol Roger remains one of the most beloved family-owned Grande Marques, eternally linked with its most famous devotee, Sir Winston Churchill. Valentin Leflaive
FRANCE - CHAMPAGNE7 products
Biodynamic (Sourced from certified vineyards)

Valentin Leflaive is a fascinating collaboration between Olivier Leflaive, of Burgundy's iconic Domaine Leflaive, and Olivier de Sousa, of Champagne's esteemed De Sousa house. This unique partnership applies a thoroughly Burgundian winemaking philosophy to the chalky terroirs of the Cote des Blancs. Focusing on single-terroir expressions and vinifying in specific Burgundy barrels, they craft highly vinous and intellectually stimulating Champagnes. Their wines are remarkably precise and mineral-driven, possessing a textural complexity and savory depth that brilliantly bridge the worlds of great white Burgundy and great Champagne.

Ampelhus - Sparkling
FRANCE - Cremant & Others7 products
Organic

A small, dynamic estate in the western Loire, Domaine Ampelhus is the project of winemaker Thibault Stephan. He is part of a new generation of growers dedicated to natural viticulture and low-intervention winemaking. Farming organically, he works primarily with the region's traditional grapes like Melon de Bourgogne and Folle Blanche. His wines are alive and full of energy, often bottled without fining or filtration. They are pure, vibrant, and saline expressions of the Atlantic-influenced terroir, offering a raw and honest glimpse into the exciting natural wine scene of the Loire.

Antech
FRANCE - Cremant & Others10 products

A pillar of the Limoux appellation for six generations, the Antech family are masters of sparkling wine, passionately championing the region's native Mauzac grape. From their cellars in Saint-Hilaire, where the world's first sparkling wine was reputedly made, they produce Blanquette and Cremant de Limoux of exceptional finesse and value. Their style is defined by elegance, bright fruit, and a fine, persistent mousse, capturing the crisp, high-altitude freshness of their terroir. Antech offers a classic and authentic taste of the Languedoc's sparkling wine heritage.

Domaine Bott-Geyl, under the direction of Jean-Christophe Bott, is a leading light in the Alsace region and a passionate advocate for biodynamic viticulture. Owned by the Vincent family for five continuous generations, Chateau Fuisse is an iconic estate and an undisputed benchmark for quality in the Maconnais. Based in the village of Fuisse, they are masters of the Pouilly-Fuisse appellation. The chateau produces only white wines, and its style is one of glorious opulence and depth. The wines are characteristically rich, powerful, and complex, often marked by a masterful integration of new oak that adds layers of spice and texture. These are not simple Chardonnays but grand, cellar-worthy white wines built for long-term aging and development.

For decades, Domaine Rolet was a pioneering, family-run estate that helped establish the modern reputation of the Jura wine region. Although recently sold, its legacy as a benchmark producer endures. Rolet established a reputation for crafting the entire spectrum of classic Jura wines with exceptional quality. This includes the crisp Trousseau and delicate Poulsard reds, and most notably, the powerful, nutty, and oxidative Savagnins, including the iconic and exceptionally age-worthy Vin Jaune. Rolet remains a touchstone for the traditional, celebrated styles of this unique region.

Francois Mikulski, of Polish heritage, established his Meursault domaine in 1992 and rapidly ascended to become one of the Cote de Beaune's most respected names. Canals Nadal
SPAIN - Cava & Corpinnat3 products

Canals Nadal is a small, family-run Cava house with a singular focus on crafting exceptional, long-aged Gran Reserva expressions. They are artisans of patience, believing that extended time on the lees is essential for achieving profound complexity and a sophisticated texture. Their Cavas, often released with minimal or no dosage, are powerful and deeply vinous, revealing layers of brioche, toasted nuts, and mature fruit over a backbone of vibrant acidity. This is a producer for those seeking a rich, creamy, and serious style of traditional method sparkling wine.

Gramona

Biodynamic

A legendary producer in Penedes, Gramona is a pioneer of world-class, long-aged sparkling wines and a leading member of the quality-focused Corpinnat group. This biodynamic estate is famous for its exceptionally long cellar aging, with top cuvees spending over a decade on the lees. This patient process, often under cork instead of crown cap, results in wines of staggering complexity, richness, and depth, with signature notes of brioche, nuts, and spice. Gramona is an undisputed benchmark, crafting profound, gastronomic sparkling wines that rival the best in the world.

Mascaro
SPAIN - Cava & Corpinnat6 products

A distinguished family-owned producer in Penedes, Mascaro stands out for its dual expertise in crafting both high-quality Cava and artisanal spirits like brandy. For their Cavas, they use only estate-grown, traditional grape varieties and adhere to a philosophy of long aging on the lees to develop complexity. This results in sparkling wines with a distinct personality, showcasing pure, vibrant fruit, a refined texture, and a gastronomic character. Mascaro represents a classic, versatile, and time-honored expression of the Cava designation.

J. Coudray-Bizot
FRANCE · BURGUNDY · Cote de Nuits13 products
Practicing Organic

J. Coudray-Bizot is a tiny, traditionalist domaine based in Beaune that operates on a unique model. They are firm believers in the importance of bottle age, holding their wines in their cellars for an exceptionally long time and only releasing them to the market when they are deemed mature and ready to be enjoyed. This practice is a rarity in modern Burgundy. As a result, both their red and white wines offer the distinct pleasure of maturity upon purchase, showcasing complex secondary and tertiary aromas, elegant structures, and seamless terroir expression.

Michel Gros (Vosne-Romanee)
FRANCE · BURGUNDY · Cote de Nuits25 products
Sustainable (Lutte Raisonnee)

Hailing from the legendary Gros family of Vosne-Romanee, Michel Gros crafts wines that are the epitome of the village's famed elegance. His most prized holding is the Premier Cru "Clos des Reas," a monopole (an appellation owned entirely by one producer) that he farms meticulously. His red wines are defined by their aromatic purity, showcasing bright red fruits and floral notes, backed by a refined structure and exceptionally silky tannins. They are the essence of Vosne-Romanee's charm. He produces very little white wine.

Michel Noellat is a highly respected Vosne-Romanee estate renowned for its precise, immaculately clean, and modernly elegant style. Antoine Jobard (Meursault)
FRANCE · BURGUNDY · Cote de Beaune3 products
Practicing Organic

Antoine Jobard, son of the revered Francois Jobard, is a master of Meursault. His domaine is the epitome of meticulous, patient winemaking, with an unwavering focus on vineyard health and exceptionally long aging in his cool cellars before the wines are even considered for release. His style is centered on producing some of Burgundy's most age-worthy white wines. When young, they are famously austere, but with time, they unfurl to reveal incredible precision, a chiseled mineral core, and profound complexity. They are wines that demand patience and reward it handsomely.

Armand Heitz
FRANCE · BURGUNDY · Cote de Beaune31 products
Organic (Practicing Agroecology)

Operating from his family's base in Chassagne-Montrachet, Armand Heitz is a dynamic young winemaker making waves in the Cote de Beaune. He has fully embraced sustainable practices, championing agroecology and polyculture across his vineyards to foster biodiversity and soil health. This thoughtful approach is reflected in his wines. His whites are celebrated for their precision and distinct saline minerality, offering a pure expression of their terroir. His reds, often fermented with whole clusters, are models of elegance and aromatic finesse, defined by fine, silky tannins rather than sheer power.

Bruno Colin is a premier Chassagne-Montrachet producer who has mastered the art of crafting Chardonnay with a reductive, high-energy profile. These are wines of incredible tension, flinty minerality, and linear acidity, where rich citrus concentration intertwines with a textbook, vibrating Chassagne terroir character.

In Pommard, Caroline Parent represents the 13th generation of winemakers at Domaine Parent, one of the Cote de Beaune's most historic family estates. Francois Mikulski, of Polish heritage, established his Meursault domaine in 1992 and rapidly ascended to become one of the Cote de Beaune's most respected names. He is lauded for crafting wines of exceptional purity and drive. His white wines are the main event, celebrated for their focused energy, tension, and piercing minerality, deliberately avoiding the heavier, broader style of Meursault. They are vibrant and precisely defined. His red wines, from appellations like Volnay, are made in a complementary style: elegant, bright, and fruit-forward.

Hubert Lamy (Saint-Aubin)
FRANCE · BURGUNDY · Cote de Beaune5 products
Sustainable (Lutte Raisonnee)

Domaine Hubert Lamy, now brilliantly run by Olivier Lamy, is a superstar estate in Saint-Aubin. Olivier is a meticulous and innovative vigneron, celebrated for his high-density plantings and his work in elevating the reputation of his home appellation. He produces some of the most chiseled, intense, and age-worthy white Burgundies available today. The style is one of searing energy, profound stony minerality, and incredible tension, consistently crafting wines from Saint-Aubin that rival the best of the more famous Cote de Beaune villages.

Jacques Prieur
FRANCE · BURGUNDY · Cote de Beaune12 products
Sustainable (HVE)

Domaine Jacques Prieur, located in Meursault, holds one of the most enviable vineyard portfolios in all of Burgundy. It is the only estate to own parcels in the five most legendary Grand Crus of both colors: Montrachet, Corton-Charlemagne, Chambertin, Musigny, and Clos de Vougeot. This incredible collection allows them to produce wines that are benchmarks of their respective terroirs. The whites are typically opulent, rich, and layered, while the reds are powerful, deep, and concentrated, with both styles renowned for their profound complexity and immense potential for aging.

FRANCE · BURGUNDY · Cote de Beaune4 products

La Pousse d'Or is a cult producer in Volnay, implementing progressive and sustainable biodynamic practices across their historic holdings. The use of prolonged, cold maceration and delayed malolactic fermentation maximizes aromatic complexity and depth of color. Their wines are hedonistic and profound-a textbook expression of Volnay silk, featuring ethereal red berry fruit, fine-grained tannins, and an exceptional sense of space on the palate.

Lucien Boillot (now managed by Pierre Boillot) offers a rare opportunity to experience the terroirs of both Gevrey-Chambertin and Volnay through the lens of a single classicist master. The approach is highly traditional: 100% destemming and very judicious use of new oak (around 30%). This is a style that champions transparency and elegance, driven by vivacious acidity and the authentic, unmasked specificities of each vineyard.

Nicolas Rossignol (Volnay)
FRANCE · BURGUNDY · Cote de Beaune14 products
Organic

Based in Volnay, Nicolas Rossignol is a fifth-generation winemaker who has quickly become a star in the Cote de Beaune. A key feature of his winemaking is the skillful use of a high percentage of whole-cluster fermentation, which he believes adds aromatic complexity, spice, and structural backbone to his wines. This results in red wines from Volnay, Pommard, and Beaune that are deeply colored, concentrated, and structured, with a savory complexity that makes them compelling. His white wines are equally distinct, showing a tense, stony, and precise character.

Andre Bonhomme (Vire-Clesse)
FRANCE · BURGUNDY · Maconnais11 products

Based in Vire in the Maconnais, Andre Bonhomme is a true pioneer, having been one of the first in the region to begin bottling his own wines back in 1956. This family-run estate focuses exclusively on old-vine Chardonnay, crafting whites that stand as a benchmark for the Macon-Vire appellation. Their wines are not simple quaffers; instead, they are renowned for their impressive richness, concentration, and structural complexity, often requiring a few years in the cellar to reveal their full potential. They are a testament to the age-worthiness of great Maconnais Chardonnay, showcasing layers of fruit and mineral depth.

Chateau Fuisse (Pouilly-Fuisse)
FRANCE · BURGUNDY · Maconnais6 products

Owned by the Vincent family for five continuous generations, Chateau Fuisse is an iconic estate and an undisputed benchmark for quality in the Maconnais. Based in the village of Fuisse, they are masters of the Pouilly-Fuisse appellation. The chateau produces only white wines, and its style is one of glorious opulence and depth. The wines are characteristically rich, powerful, and complex, often marked by a masterful integration of new oak that adds layers of spice and texture. These are not simple Chardonnays but grand, cellar-worthy white wines built for long-term aging and development.

SOUTH-WEST

Chateau Tour de Gendres
FRANCE · SOUTH-WEST1 product
Biodynamic

Chateau Tour des Gendres, run by the de Conti family, is a pioneering estate in the Bergerac region, just east of Bordeaux. They were among the very first in the area to convert to organic and biodynamic farming, a commitment that results in wines of exceptional vibrancy and purity. They produce a diverse range of styles, but are best known for their expressive whites based on Sauvignon Blanc and Semillon, and their characterful reds from classic Bordeaux varieties. Their wines are honest, full of life, and represent the incredible potential of Bergerac's terroir.

PROVENCE

Chateau de l'Escarelle
FRANCE · PROVENCE5 products
Organic

Nestled in the heart of the Cotes de Provence appellation, Chateau de l'Escaralle is a large, historic estate committed to showcasing the classic character of the region. With over 100 hectares of vines, the chateau has invested heavily in sustainable viticulture to protect its beautiful natural surroundings. They are best known for producing archetypal Provence rose that is pale salmon in color, crisp, and refreshingly aromatic. The wines deliver the expected and delightful profile of bright red berries, citrus zest, and a clean, mineral finish, embodying the Provencal lifestyle.

Chateau l'Arnaude
FRANCE · PROVENCE2 products
Sustainable (HVE)

Nestled in the heart of Provence near Lorgues, Chateau l'Arnaude is a charming estate that beautifully blends winemaking with Provencal hospitality. They produce a range of classic AOP Cotes de Provence wines, focusing on a style that is both elegant and expressive of the region's sun-drenched terroir. The estate is particularly celebrated for its rose, 'Nuit Blanche.' True to its name, the grapes for this cuvee are harvested at night to capture maximum freshness and aromatic intensity, resulting in a quintessential gastronomic rose-pale, vibrant, and sophisticated.

Chateau Saint-Maur
FRANCE · PROVENCE3 products
Sustainable

Located just outside the glamorous village of Saint-Tropez, Chateau Saint-Maur is a prestigious, Cru Classe estate that represents the luxurious side of Provence. The property is dedicated to producing high-end, gastronomic rose with a focus on elegance and refinement. The winemaking is precise, resulting in wines that are exquisitely balanced, with subtle aromatic complexity and a silky, palate-coating texture. Chateau Saint-Maur is a clear expression of the ambition in modern Provence to create world-class wines that can compete on the finest tables.

Clos Cibonne
FRANCE · PROVENCE14 products
NEWOrganic

Clos Cibonne is a unique and iconic estate in Provence, celebrated for championing the rare, indigenous Tibouren grape. What truly sets them apart is their traditional winemaking method for rose: the wine is aged for a year under fleurette (a thin veil of yeast) in large, 100-year-old barrels (foudres). This process yields a rose unlike any other-a complex, savory, and nutty wine with extraordinary texture and the ability to age for years, even decades. It is a gastronomic and singular expression that transcends the category of simple summer rose.

Domaine Ott
FRANCE · PROVENCE3 products
Practicing Organic

For over a century, Domaines Ott has been the undisputed benchmark for high-end Provence rose, effectively creating the category for luxury rose. Now owned by Louis Roederer, the estate comprises three distinct properties: Chateau de Selle, Clos Mireille, and Chateau Romassan. Their iconic bottle shape is recognized globally. The style is the epitome of elegance and subtlety; the wines are consistently pale, beautifully aromatic, and possess a delicate structure and saline minerality that makes them both effortlessly drinkable and surprisingly complex.

Domaine Saint Andrieu
FRANCE · PROVENCE2 products

Located in the rolling hills of the Haut-Var, a cooler, higher-altitude part of Provence, Domaine Saint Andrieu is the Provencal project of Jean-Paul and Nancy Bignon, the owners of the famed Chateau Talbot in Bordeaux. Chateau de Beaucastel
FRANCE · RHONE VALLEY1 product
Organic & Biodynamic

A true icon of the Southern Rhone, Chateau de Beaucastel is a benchmark estate in Chateauneuf-du-Pape, expertly guided by the Perrin family. Pioneers of organic and biodynamic farming, they are renowned for their tradition of cultivating all 13 permitted grape varieties. Their wines are celebrated for their structure, complexity, and incredible longevity. In the finest years, they produce the legendary 'Hommage a Jacques Perrin,' a rare, old-vine Mourvedre-dominant cuvee that stands as one of the world's most profound and age-worthy wines.

Situated at the foot of the Dentelles de Montmirail, Chateau de Saint Cosme is a benchmark estate in Gigondas, steered by the talented and fiercely traditional Louis Barruol. Working with ancient family vineyards, Barruol crafts wines of incredible depth and longevity. The house style is defined by a commitment to whole-cluster fermentation, which imparts a signature spicy, savory complexity and robust tannic structure to the wines. These are powerful, aromatic, and deeply terroir-driven expressions of the Southern Rhone, representing the pinnacle of what Gigondas can achieve.

Chateau Grillet
FRANCE · RHONE VALLEY2 products
Biodynamic

Chateau Grillet is a wine of legend-a tiny, 3.5-hectare monopole that is an entire AOC unto itself. Now under the same ownership as Domaine d'Eugenie, this historic amphitheater of vines planted exclusively to Viognier is one of the world's most unique terroirs. The wine it produces is the ultimate expression of its grape: an intensely aromatic and complex white with notes of apricot, honeysuckle, and violet. With a characteristic textural richness balanced by a stony minerality, Chateau Grillet is a powerful, age-worthy, and singular icon of the Northern Rhone.

Chateau Rayas - E. Reynaud
FRANCE · RHONE VALLEY13 products
Practicing Organic (Uncertified Traditionalist)

An estate of mythic status, Chateau Rayas is an outlier in Chateauneuf-du-Pape, producing wines unlike any other in the region. Under the reclusive and brilliant Emmanuel Reynaud, the domaine crafts a 100% Grenache cuvee from sandy, north-facing vineyards. The wine is not about power but about perfume and ethereal texture; it is an incredibly aromatic, elegant, and almost Burgundian interpretation of Grenache. Aged in old casks and maddeningly difficult to acquire, Rayas is a singular expression of terroir that has become one of the most sought-after wines in the world.

Domaine du Vieux Telegraphe
FRANCE · RHONE VALLEY8 products
Sustainable (HVE)

As the flagship estate of the Brunier family, Domaine du Vieux Telegraphe is a grand classic and a benchmark for Chateauneuf-du-Pape. The wine's distinct character comes from its prime location on the "Plateau de la Crau," a vineyard famous for its large rounded stones (galets roules) that store heat. This terroir imparts a signature savory, almost saline minerality to the wines. Vieux Telegraphe is a model of consistency and age-worthiness, producing a structured, complex, and powerful Grenache-based blend that beautifully balances robust fruit with herbal, spicy, and mineral notes.

Eric Texier
FRANCE · RHONE VALLEY11 products
Organic

A self-described "negociant-vigneron," Eric Texier is a revolutionary figure in the Northern Rhone, celebrated for rehabilitating forgotten terroirs like Brezeme. He is a champion of minimal-intervention winemaking, applying his "pre-industrial" sensibility to create wines of stunning purity and vibrancy. Forsaking modern additives and heavy extraction, he produces Syrah, Viognier, and Roussanne that are incredibly fresh, transparent, and expressive of their granitic soils. These are wines that speak of place with crystalline clarity, energy, and a distinctive savory edge.

M. Chapoutier is a dominant force in the Rhone Valley, a globally recognized brand that has nonetheless maintained a fierce commitment to terroir. From his base in Tain-l'Hermitage, Michel Chapoutier has championed biodynamic farming on a massive scale and famously includes Braille on all his labels. The house style is one of power, depth, and precision, with his single-parcel "Selections Parcellaires" from Hermitage, Cote-Rotie, and Chateauneuf-du-Pape standing as iconic, world-class wines. They are rich, complex, and built to reflect their exact place of origin with profound intensity.

Thierry Allemand
FRANCE · RHONE VALLEY9 products
Practicing Organic (Uncertified Traditionalist)

Thierry Allemand is a cult figure and a true master of Cornas. Without any inherited vineyards, he painstakingly pieced together a small domaine on the appellation's steepest granite slopes. He is a traditionalist who has perfected the art of whole-cluster fermentation, producing wines of unparalleled aromatic complexity and structural elegance. His Cornas are wild and savory, bursting with notes of violets, olives, and smoked meat. They possess a rare combination of rustic soulfulness and polished finesse, making them some of the most thrilling and age-worthy Syrahs on the planet.

Sebastien Riffault is one of the most talked-about and controversial winemakers in Sancerre. He farms his vineyards biodynamically with the help of his horse, Salto, and pushes the boundaries of the appellation with his radical, non-interventionist cellar work. Moulin Touchais
FRANCE · LOIRE VALLEY9 products
NEW

Moulin Touchais holds legendary status in Coteaux du Layon, famed for sweet Chenin Blanc wines that age for decades. Their unique methodology requires harvesting in two passes: an early pass for acidity and a late pass, often with Botrytis cinerea, for richness. This creates an immortal balance-wines that unfold with aromas of dried apricot, honey, and mushroom, retaining astonishing acidic tension even after half a century.

Domaine Bott-Geyl, under the direction of Jean-Christophe Bott, is a leading light in the Alsace region and a passionate advocate for biodynamic viticulture. Based in Beblenheim, the domaine produces a stunning range of terroir-driven wines from its Grand Cru holdings. Laurent Bannwarth
FRANCE · ALSACE1 product
Biodynamic/Natural

Laurent Bannwarth is a true maverick and experimentalist in the Alsatian village of Obermorschwihr. Together with his wife Suzanne, he has pushed the boundaries of natural winemaking, embracing techniques like long-term skin maceration (orange wines), aging in amphorae, and bottling with zero added sulfur. Their wines are a thrilling and often wild expression of Alsatian grapes, prioritizing energy, texture, and life above all else. A bottle from Bannwarth offers a completely different, thought-provoking perspective on what the wines of Alsace can be.

Zind Humbrecht

Biodynamic

Domaine Zind-Humbrecht is a titan of Alsace, an estate whose influence is felt globally. Led by the brilliant Olivier Humbrecht, France's first Master of Wine, the domaine is a pioneer and world leader in biodynamic viticulture. From their legendary Grand Cru holdings like Rangen and Clos Saint Urbain, they produce wines of breathtaking power, concentration, and terroir transparency. The style is unapologetically rich and complex, often finishing with a touch of residual sugar that is perfectly balanced by acidity and profound minerality. A bottle from Zind-Humbrecht is a singular experience-a powerful, age-worthy, and profound expression of Alsace's greatest sites.

For decades, Domaine Rolet was a pioneering, family-run estate that helped establish the modern reputation of the Jura wine region. Although recently sold, its legacy as a benchmark producer endures. Rolet remains a touchstone for the traditional, celebrated styles of this unique region.

Brothers Pascal and Jean-Marc Verhaeghe of Chateau du Cedre are widely credited with transforming the perception of Cahors. They took the region's powerful Malbec (known locally as Cot) and, through meticulous organic farming and precise winemaking, elevated it to a new level of refinement. Their wines are intensely dark and concentrated, yet they possess a remarkable polish, balance, and complexity that was once rare in the appellation. Chateau du Cedre is the undisputed benchmark for modern, high-quality Cahors, producing powerful, age-worthy reds of world-class stature.

Chateau Tour des Gendres, run by the de Conti family, is a pioneering estate in the Bergerac region, just east of Bordeaux. They were among the very first in the area to convert to organic and biodynamic farming, a commitment that results in wines of exceptional vibrancy and purity. They produce a diverse range of styles, but are best known for their expressive whites based on Sauvignon Blanc and Semillon, and their characterful reds from classic Bordeaux varieties. Their wines are honest, full of life, and represent the incredible potential of Bergerac's terroir.

Clos Uroulat
FRANCE · SOUTH WEST5 products

Clos Uroulat is the elite of the Jurancon appellation, directed by Charles Hours. The estate produces benchmark dry and late-harvest sweet wines from the Petit Manseng grape. Yields are severely restricted in the vineyard, and fermentation occurs in older oak barrels. The result is incredibly concentrated wine, exuding exotic fruits and white truffle, pierced by a steely, vibrating, and relentlessly long acidity.

Domaine Drouet - Pineau de Charentes
FRANCE · SOUTH WEST5 products

From their estate in the prestigious Grande Champagne cru of Cognac, the Drouet family apply their deep expertise in distillation to craft exceptional Pineau des Charentes. This traditional mistelle is created by blending fresh grape must with their own fine Cognac eau-de-vie before aging in French oak. The result is a beautifully balanced fortified wine, with luscious notes of honey, apricot, and nuts, all underpinned by a remarkable freshness. Drouet's Pineau is a benchmark for its elegance and complexity, a true expression of artisanal craftsmanship.

Located in the coastal Maremma region of Tuscany, Ampeleia is a unique project founded by the celebrated winemaker Elisabetta Foradori. The estate is a testament to biodiversity, with vineyards spread across different altitudes and soil types, farmed biodynamically. They focus on Mediterranean grape varieties, particularly Alicante Nero (Grenache), Carignano, and Mourvedre. The resulting wines are vibrant and full of life, showcasing bright fruit, herbal complexity, and a distinct mineral freshness. Ampeleia offers a soulful and compelling alternative vision of Tuscan wine.

Antinori - Solaia

Solaia is one of the original "Super Tuscans" and an icon of Italian wine, produced by the legendary Antinori family. Born from the sunniest part of the Tignanello vineyard, it is a powerful blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, and Sangiovese. First produced in 1978, Solaia consistently demonstrates the incredible synergy between these grapes on Tuscan soil. It is a wine of immense structure, depth, and complexity, celebrated for its aristocratic polish and profound aging potential, firmly cementing its place in the pantheon of the world's greatest wines.

Capanna produces structured, age-worthy, and quintessentially classic Brunello that speaks of its place with grace and authority.

Located in the Colli Aretini of Tuscany, Petrolo is a high-quality estate most famous for its cult classic, "Galatrona," a monumental 100% Merlot. Petrolo is a benchmark for single-varietal Merlot in Italy, proving that the grape can achieve extraordinary heights in this part of Tuscany.

Podere il Carnasciale is a unique, cult estate in the hills of Tuscany that is singularly devoted to the rare Caberlot grape-a naturally occurring hybrid of Cabernet Franc and Merlot. Home to Sassicaia, the original Super Tuscan, Tenuta San Guido is arguably Italy's most famous wine estate. Located in Bolgheri, the Marchese Mario Incisa della Rocchetta planted Cabernet Sauvignon in the 1940s, and the resulting wine would go on to revolutionize Italian wine. Sassicaia is celebrated for its aristocratic elegance, complex savory notes, and incredible aging potential. It is a wine of unparalleled finesse and nobility that proved Italian terroir could produce a Cabernet blend to rival the best in the world, earning its own exclusive DOC Bolgheri Sassicaia.

Elio Altare

Elio Altare is one of the original and most influential modernists who revolutionized winemaking in Barolo. In a now-famous act of rebellion, he took a chainsaw to his family's old barrels, ushering in an era of shorter macerations and aging in small French oak to create a more approachable and aromatic style of Nebbiolo. His wines are defined by their purity of fruit, polished tannins, and explosive aromatics. Sourced from top crus like Arborina, his Barolos are beautifully crafted, elegant, and remain a benchmark for the refined, modern style.

G.D. Vajra is a family-run estate celebrated for producing Barolos of exceptional elegance, perfume, and finesse. While respecting tradition, they are known for their meticulous, almost Burgundian approach to viticulture and winemaking. Their style is defined by bright aromatics, vibrant acidity, and finely sculpted tannins, prioritizing grace over sheer power. Their flagship, "Bricco delle Viole," is a benchmark for high-altitude Nebbiolo, and they are also noted for reviving rare local grapes like Freisa, making them a bastion of both quality and Piemontese heritage.

Barbaresco
Gaja
ITALY · PIEDMONT · Barbaresco19 products
Practicing Organic/Biodynamic (Uncertified)

Angelo Gaja is a legendary figure who catapulted Piedmont, and particularly Barbaresco, onto the world stage. He introduced international standards of quality, including the use of French barriques and the then-radical practice of planting French varieties like Cabernet Sauvignon. The Gaja style is one of impeccable polish, power, and complexity. His Barbaresco and single-vineyard Sori bottlings are icons of modern Italian wine, renowned for their intensity, flawless balance, and incredible capacity for aging, representing the pinnacle of ambition and quality.

Braida di Giacomo Bologna is the estate that single-handedly revolutionized the perception of the Barbera grape, elevating it from a simple local quaffer to a world-class wine. The late Giacomo Bologna was a true visionary, and his iconic "Bricco dell'Uccellone" proved that Barbera, when planted in top sites and aged in small oak barrels, could be rich, complex, and age-worthy. Today, his children Raffaella and Giuseppe continue his legacy, producing benchmark Barbera d'Asti wines that are defined by their exuberant fruit, vibrant acidity, and polished, luxurious texture.

A historic, family-run estate in Alto Adige, Franz Haas is renowned for its obsession with Pinot Nero, a grape notoriously difficult to perfect in Italy. Their winemaking is a masterful blend of aromatic purity and alpine freshness. The Pinot Nero is celebrated for its elegance and complexity, while their aromatic whites, such as Manna and Moscato Rosa, are vibrant and impeccably balanced. Characterized by their distinctive artist-designed labels, the wines of Franz Haas are a quintessential expression of the precision and elegance possible in this mountainous northern Italian terroir.

The late Giuseppe "Bepi" Quintarelli was the legendary, undisputed master of Amarone, a man whose uncompromising traditional methods and zen-like patience became the stuff of legend. His estate, now run by his family, continues to produce wines of mythical status that are released only after years of aging in large old casks. The Quintarelli style is one of staggering complexity, ethereal texture, and near-endless longevity. Kris (Franz Haas)

A historic, family-run estate in Alto Adige, Franz Haas is renowned for its obsession with Pinot Nero, a grape notoriously difficult to perfect in Italy. Their winemaking is a masterful blend of aromatic purity and alpine freshness. The Pinot Nero is celebrated for its elegance and complexity, while their aromatic whites, such as Manna and Moscato Rosa, are vibrant and impeccably balanced. Characterized by their distinctive artist-designed labels, the wines of Franz Haas are a quintessential expression of the precision and elegance possible in this mountainous northern Italian terroir.

Castello Solicchiata

Castello Solicchiata is a rare, historically aristocratic wine project on the slopes of Mount Etna (Adrano), cultivating Bordeaux varietals in a highly atypical terroir. Vinification follows the old French chateau tradition, utilizing long macerations and barrique aging. The volcanic soils impart a distinctive graphite and smoke nuance to the classic Cabernet blend, maintaining a firm, rigid structure that requires time to yield.

FRIULI

Gravner
ITALY · FRIULI2 products
Organic/Natural

Josko Gravner is a legendary and uncompromising winemaker in Friuli, considered a founding father of the modern "orange wine" movement. He famously abandoned conventional techniques to ferment his Ribolla Gialla and other white grapes in large terracotta amphorae buried underground, with extended skin contact. The resulting wines are profound, challenging, and deeply complex, possessing a unique tannic structure, amber hue, and savory notes of dried apricot, tea, and spice. A bottle from Gravner is not just a wine, but a singular, meditative experience.

A historic family estate in Friuli's Colli Orientali, Ronchi di Cialla is celebrated for its pioneering work in rescuing and championing endangered native grape varieties. They are most famous for their incredible expressions of Schioppettino, a red grape they single-handedly saved from extinction, and for their complex sweet wines from Picolit and Verduzzo. Their style is deeply traditional and terroir-driven, producing structured, savory, and exceptionally long-lived wines that speak with the unique and authentic voice of their specific corner of Friuli.

Sartarelli is a specialist, a house entirely devoted to showcasing the multifaceted beauty of Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi. Gianfranco Fino has become a cult figure in Puglia, crafting some of Italy's most powerful and critically acclaimed red wines. He is a master of Primitivo, sourced from meticulously farmed old bush vines (alberello) in Manduria. Lopez de Heredia
SPAIN · RIOJA17 products
Practicing Organic (Uncertified Traditionalist)

Vina Tondonia, the flagship estate of R. Lopez de Heredia, is a living monument to the history of traditional Rioja. This fiercely uncompromising family bodega produces wines in the same way they did over a century ago, employing native yeasts, huge old oak vats, and extraordinarily long aging in barrel and bottle before release. Their wines, both red and the legendary white Gran Reserva, are unique and profound, with a savory, oxidative complexity and ethereal texture that can only be achieved with time. They are a true taste of history and a pillar of world wine heritage.

Yjar is a rare and exciting new wine from the legendary Rioja estate of Remirez de Ganuza, conceived by winemaker Telmo Rodriguez. Aalto was founded in 1999 by the legendary winemaker Mariano Garcia (formerly of Vega Sicilia) and Javier Zaccagnini, and it quickly became an icon of modern Ribera del Duero. While Gramona's legendary status is built on their profound sparkling wines, their still offerings are a testament to their deep commitment to Penedes terroir. Algueira is a pioneering estate in the breathtakingly steep and dramatic landscape of Ribeira Sacra in Galicia. Working on terraced vineyards that plunge down to the Sil river, Fernando Gonzalez and Ana Perez champion indigenous grape varieties, particularly Mencia for reds and Godello for whites. This is "heroic viticulture" at its finest, producing wines that are incredibly fresh, aromatic, and mineral-driven. The Algueira style is one of elegance and purity, capturing the vibrant, peppery, and floral character of Mencia from this unique, cool-climate terroir.

Niepoort - unfortified

While famous for Port, Dirk Niepoort has also been a revolutionary force in Portuguese table wine. From the steep schist slopes of the Douro Valley, he crafts unfortified wines of incredible elegance, freshness, and complexity. His reds, like "Redoma" and "Batuta," are vibrant and mineral-driven, often compared to Burgundy or Barolo, while his whites are saline and chiseled. The Niepoort style is defined by a minimal-intervention approach, prioritizing acidity and terroir expression over power, and has redefined the potential of the Douro.

The Pockl family are masters of powerful, opulent red wines from the warm Seewinkel sub-region of Burgenland. Kechris

The Kechris winery, located near Thessaloniki in northern Greece, is the undisputed master of Retsina. For three generations, the family has been dedicated to elevating this traditional Greek wine from a simple tavern quaff to a fine, complex, and world-class beverage. Using high-quality Assyrtiko and Roditis grapes and fresh pine resin from local forests, they craft modern Retsina of remarkable elegance and aromatic finesse. Their flagship, "Tear of the Pine," is a benchmark that showcases the incredible gastronomic potential of this uniquely Greek wine style.

Geri metai

'Geri Metai' ('Good Year') is a highly specialized artisan winery in Lithuania, dedicated to mastering the rare art of Rowanberry wine. What sets them apart is their deep exploration of the plant itself, crafting distinct wines from different clones of the Rowan tree. This meticulous approach allows them to showcase the subtle nuances of each clone, creating beverages of remarkable complexity, balancing the berry's natural tartness with aromatic notes of bitter almond and wild fruit. Geri Metai produces truly unique wines that represent the pinnacle of niche Lithuanian craftsmanship.

Roksala is a true pioneer in Lithuanian viticulture, courageously shifting focus from traditional fruit wines to those made from grapes. They are among the first to successfully cultivate and vinify cold-hardy grape varieties like St. Pepin, Monika, and Marquette in the challenging northern climate. While their grape wines are setting a new precedent for the region, Roksala also produces a terrific sparkling rhubarb wine, celebrated for its crisp, vibrant, and refreshingly aromatic character. They are a key player in defining the future of modern Lithuanian winemaking.

Giorgi Somomnishvili is an artisan winemaker in the Kakheti region, dedicated to preserving Georgia's most ancient and traditional winemaking techniques. He farms his vineyards organically and produces his wines exclusively in qvevri-large clay amphorae buried underground. Working with native grapes like Rkatsiteli and Saperavi, he crafts wines with extended skin contact, resulting in amber wines of incredible texture, complexity, and savory depth. His wines are a pure, unfiltered, and soulful expression of the 8,000-year-old Georgian winemaking heritage.

A historic and pioneering estate founded in 1870, Vina Errazuriz is a pillar of Chilean fine wine. From their base in the Aconcagua Valley, they produce a world-class portfolio that consistently demonstrates the quality potential of Chilean terroir. Their iconic wines, including "Don Maximiano Founder's Reserve" and the "Kai" Carmenere, are benchmarks for their respective styles-powerful, elegant, and complex. Errazuriz expertly balances rich fruit concentration with polished structure, crafting sophisticated wines that are among the finest in South America.

Sena was born in 1995 as a groundbreaking partnership between Eduardo Chadwick of Errazuriz and Robert Mondavi of Napa Valley. The style is one of profound elegance, complexity, and aging potential, showcasing a perfect balance of rich fruit, savory herbal notes, and a polished, seamless structure that has earned it a place among the world's elite wines.

NON ALCO ALTERNATIVES2 products
Sustainable/Practicing Organic

A leading estate in the Rheingau, Georg Breuer is celebrated for its pioneering work in producing world-class dry Rieslings. Under the direction of the late Bernhard Breuer and now his daughter Theresa, the winery championed the revival of top vineyard sites. Their flagship wines from crus like Berg Schlossberg and Rauenthal Nonnenberg are icons of German dry Riesling-powerful, intensely mineralic, and built with a chiseled structure for decades of aging. They are profound, intellectual wines that represent the pinnacle of their genre.

Van Nahmen - Juices & sparking tea
NON ALCO ALTERNATIVES15 products

A revered German family-run fruit press since 1917, Van Nahmen is a benchmark for artisanal, single-varietal juices. They champion the concept of 'fruit terroir,' sourcing rare and old-heritage fruits from local orchards to craft beverages of stunning purity and depth. Their juices and sparkling teas are never from concentrate, offering a true, unadulterated expression of the specific fruit variety. Van Nahmen represents the pinnacle of gastronomic, non-alcoholic beverages, showcasing incredible complexity and character.

Limonio is an artisanal producer in Sicily, dedicated to crafting exceptional liqueurs from ingredients grown in their own organic citrus groves. COGNAC /ARMAGNAC /BRANDY8 products

From their estate in the prestigious Grande Champagne cru of Cognac, the Drouet family apply their deep expertise in distillation to craft exceptional Pineau des Charentes. This traditional mistelle is created by blending fresh grape must with their own fine Cognac eau-de-vie before aging in French oak. The result is a beautifully balanced fortified wine, with luscious notes of honey, apricot, and nuts, all underpinned by a remarkable freshness. Drouet's Pineau is a benchmark for its elegance and complexity, a true expression of artisanal craftsmanship.

Born - Sake
SAKE4 products

Born is a prestigious sake brand from the Katoukichibee Shouten brewery in Fukui, renowned for its mastery of long-term, low-temperature aging. The name symbolizes purity and truth, a philosophy reflected in their exceptionally elegant and complex sakes. By maturing their creations at sub-zero temperatures, they achieve a remarkable smoothness, deep umami, and a pristine, clean finish. A benchmark for sophisticated, aged sake, Born is celebrated for its refined character and is frequently served at Japanese state functions.

IWA 5 is a groundbreaking, ultra-premium sake created by Richard Geoffroy, the former legendary Chef de Cave of Dom Perignon. Applying a revolutionary Champagne philosophy of 'assemblage' to Japanese sake, each release is a masterful blend of multiple rice varieties and yeast strains. The style is one of extraordinary complexity, balance, and luminosity, with a seamless texture and a remarkably persistent finish. IWA 5 is a modern icon, redefining the possibilities of sake through the art of the blend.

Ninki Ichi represents the dynamic and accessible face of modern craft sake, blending time-honored methods with a contemporary palate.

Kuramoto Yamada is a respected sake brewery from Gifu, dedicated to a philosophy of quality and craftsmanship. In contrast, their Kai Junmai offers a wonderfully expressive and versatile profile, perfect for pairing, showcasing the pure umami character of the rice.

CIDER2 producers · 17 products

Pierre Huet - cider
CIDER12 products

A prestigious family-owned estate in Normandy, Pierre Huet is celebrated for its exceptional Calvados and artisanal ciders. With control over high-quality orchards, they apply generations of expertise to their craft. Their ciders are a pure expression of Normandy's terroir, known for their aromatic complexity, fine bubbles, and a perfect balance between fruitiness and savory, rustic notes. Pierre Huet represents the more gastronomic and age-worthy side of cider, produced with the same care and precision as their world-renowned spirits.

RUM3 producers · 13 products

Cihuatan
RUM11 products

Cihuatan is the first and only rum distillery in El Salvador, a craft producer reviving the country's ancient Mayan heritage. The brand has a special connection to Lithuania, as one of its co-founders, Alfredo Pacas, has Lithuanian roots. They control the entire process from sugarcane to bottling, producing rums aged in a variety of barrels. The style is typically rich and complex, with a signature profile of dark chocolate, coffee, and spice, offering a unique and compelling taste of Central American rum craftsmanship.
